notes.title: Update Notes for July 7th, 2021.
notes.content: Fixed a bug found inside the cave section that was mentioned by one review of the game.

notes.title: UPDATE FOR 25th OF APRIL
notes.content:
The game now has [b]full controller support[/b]. You are able to play the entire game with Playstation or Xbox controllers. Hopefully this'll make for a better experience for some of you who didn't enjoy the keyboard and mouse controls!

Good luck playing!
